pages.text: 咘咘的小小问候 / BUBU'S LITTLE HELLO
pages.text_en: BUBU'S LITTLE HELLO

pages.text: 出门前，妈妈告诉咘咘：“今天我们去姑奶奶家，姑爷爷也在。”咘咘点点头，妈妈说：“你可以先笑一笑，也可以挥挥手，不用一下子就喊人。”
pages.text_en: Before going out, Mommy tells Bubu, "Today we are going to Grandaunt's house. Granduncle will be there too." Bubu nods. Mommy says, "You can smile first, or wave. You don't have to call out right away."

pages.text: 在家里，妈妈和 NOMI 陪咘咘排练。NOMI 站在对面，笑着挥了挥手。咘咘躲在妈妈身后，只伸出一只小手，轻轻挥了挥，NOMI 点点头说：“这样就很好。”
pages.text_en: At home, Mommy and NOMI rehearse with Bubu. NOMI stands across from her and waves with a smile. Bubu hides behind Mommy, stretches out one little hand, and waves gently. NOMI nods and says, "That is just right."

pages.text: 到了姑奶奶家，咘咘先坐在妈妈身边，悄悄看一看。姑奶奶想抱她，她一下子躲到妈妈身后，小手紧紧抓住妈妈的裙子。
pages.text_en: At Grandaunt's house, Bubu first sits beside Mommy and looks around quietly. Grandaunt wants to hug her, and Bubu quickly hides behind Mommy, holding Mommy's skirt tight with her little hand.

pages.text: 妈妈不催她，也不替她道歉，只轻轻说：“她先看一看，我们等一等。”姑奶奶点点头，把一盘点心放在桌子上，又把小兔子放在咘咘看得见的地方。
pages.text_en: Mommy does not rush her and does not say sorry for her. She says softly, "She will look first. Let's wait a little." Grandaunt nods, puts a plate of snacks on the table, and places the little bunny where Bubu can see it.

pages.text: NOMI 先挥了挥手，NONO 在空中转了个圈，COCO 笑着说：“Hello！你好！”咘咘看着他们，慢慢伸出手，挥了挥手。后来，他们一起玩积木，咘咘小声说：“今天，我挥挥手了。”
pages.text_en: NOMI waves first. NONO spins in the air. COCO smiles and says, "Hello! 你好!" Watching them, Bubu slowly stretches out her hand and waves. Later they play with blocks together, and Bubu says softly, "Today, I waved."

pages.text: 这一次，姑奶奶和姑爷爷要来我们家。妈妈告诉咘咘：“今天他们来我们家，你可以试试，先挥手，再说 hello。”咘咘在家里和 NOMI 排练了一次，挥手，hello，挥手，hello。
pages.text_en: This time, Grandaunt and Granduncle are coming to our house. Mommy tells Bubu, "Today they are coming here. You can try: wave first, then say hello." At home Bubu rehearses with NOMI once: wave, hello, wave, hello.

pages.text: 门铃响了，姑奶奶和姑爷爷来了。咘咘站在客厅里，先挥了挥手，姑奶奶笑着也挥了挥手。咘咘看着姑奶奶的笑脸，深吸了一口气，小声说：“hello。”
pages.text_en: The doorbell rings. Grandaunt and Granduncle are here. Standing in the living room, Bubu waves first, and Grandaunt waves back with a smile. Looking at Grandaunt's smiling face, Bubu takes a deep breath and says softly, "hello."

pages.text: COCO 在旁边说：“Hello 就是你好，你说出来了！”NONO 高兴地转了个圈，NOMI 点点头说：“你自己试了，真好。”咘咘的脸红红的，可是眼睛亮亮的。
pages.text_en: COCO says beside her, "Hello means 你好. You said it!" NONO spins happily. NOMI nods and says, "You tried it yourself. That is wonderful." Bubu's face is red, but her eyes are bright.

pages.text: 姑奶奶没有要求她再大声一点，只是把带来的点心放在桌子上说：“hello，咘咘。”咘咘接过点心，又挥了挥手，小声说：“hello。”
pages.text_en: Grandaunt does not ask her to be louder. She just puts the snacks she brought on the table and says, "hello, Bubu." Bubu takes a snack, waves again, and says softly, "hello."

pages.text: 长辈走了以后，咘咘拉着妈妈的手说：“今天，我挥了手，还说了 hello。”妈妈摸摸她的头说：“你一次只进一小步，就已经很好了。”
pages.text_en: After Grandaunt and Granduncle leave, Bubu holds Mommy's hand and says, "Today, I waved and I said hello." Mommy pats her head and says, "One little step at a time is already wonderful."

pages.text: 下一次，大家一起出去吃饭。妈妈告诉咘咘：“今天在饭店里，你可以试试喊人了。”咘咘在家里排练：挥手，hello，姑奶奶好。排练了两次，她点点头说：“我试试。”
pages.text_en: Next time, everyone goes out to eat together. Mommy tells Bubu, "Today at the restaurant, you can try calling out." At home Bubu rehearses: wave, hello, 姑奶奶好. After rehearsing twice, she nods and says, "I'll try."

pages.text: 到了饭店，咘咘先挥了挥手，又小声说：“hello。”然后，她看着姑奶奶，深吸一口气，慢慢说：“姑奶奶……好。”
pages.text_en: At the restaurant, Bubu waves first, then says softly, "hello." Then, looking at Grandaunt, she takes a deep breath and says slowly, "姑奶奶……好."

pages.text: 姑奶奶一下子笑了，轻轻抱了抱她说：“好，好，咘咘好。”姑爷爷也笑着挥了挥手，NONO 在空中转了好几个圈，COCO 拍着手说：“Hello！你做到了！”
pages.text_en: Grandaunt smiles at once and hugs her gently. "Good, good, Bubu is good." Granduncle waves with a smile. NONO spins in the air again and again. COCO claps and says, "Hello! You did it!"

pages.text: 后来，大家一起吃饭，咘咘不再一直躲在妈妈身后了。她坐在姑奶奶身边，帮姑奶奶递纸巾，偶尔抬起头，笑一笑。
pages.text_en: Later everyone eats together. Bubu does not hide behind Mommy all the time anymore. She sits beside Grandaunt, hands her a napkin, and looks up now and then with a smile.

pages.text: 回家的路上，咘咘拉着妈妈的手，认真地说：“今天，我挥了手、说了 hello、还喊了人。下次，我想试试先说你好。”妈妈笑着说：“好，我们下次再试。”
pages.text_en: On the way home, Bubu holds Mommy's hand and says seriously, "Today, I waved, I said hello, and I called out. Next time, I want to try saying 你好 first." Mommy smiles and says, "Good. We will try again next time."

pages.text: 又一次，咘咘和妈妈在路上走，妈妈没有提前告诉她会遇见谁，也没有告诉她要说什么，只笑着说：“今天，你想怎么问候，就怎么问候。”咘咘点点头，自己在心里想了一遍：挥手，hello，喊人。
pages.text_en: Once again, Bubu and Mommy are walking on the road. Mommy does not tell her in advance who they will meet, or what to say. She just smiles and says, "Today, greet them however you like." Bubu nods and goes over it in her mind: wave, hello, call out.

pages.text: 迎面走来琪琪姑姑，她是姑爷爷和姑奶奶的女儿，咘咘以前见过。妈妈站在旁边，没有走上前。咘咘自己走了过去，先挥了挥手，又说：“hello，琪琪姑姑好。”声音不大，可是很清楚。
pages.text_en: Coming toward them is Auntie Qiqi, the daughter of Granduncle and Grandaunt, whom Bubu has met before. Mommy stands beside her and does not walk up. Bubu walks over by herself, waves first, and says, "hello, 琪琪姑姑好." Her voice is not loud, but it is clear.

pages.text: 琪琪姑姑一下子笑了，说：“咘咘自己先喊人了，真好。”咘咘拉着琪琪姑姑的手说：“琪琪姑姑，我们一起去公园玩吧。”琪琪姑姑笑着点点头，大家一起往公园走去。
pages.text_en: Auntie Qiqi smiles at once and says, "Bubu called out first all by herself. Wonderful." Bubu takes Auntie Qiqi's hand and says, "Auntie Qiqi, let's go to the park together." Auntie Qiqi nods with a smile, and everyone walks to the park together.

pages.text: 回家的路上，咘咘拉着妈妈的手，骄傲地说：“今天，我自己先喊人了，不用妈妈告诉我了，连在路上遇见琪琪姑姑，我也可以自己问候。”妈妈笑着说：“对，你自己做到了。”
pages.text_en: On the way home, Bubu holds Mommy's hand and says proudly, "Today, I called out first all by myself. Mommy didn't have to tell me. Even when I meet Auntie Qiqi on the road, I can greet her myself." Mommy smiles and says, "Yes, you did it yourself."
